set_color_for_instance: set a color for a given instance ID in the InstanceColorMap class
get_color_for_instance: get the color for a given instance ID from the InstanceColorMap class
remove_color_for_instance: remove the color mapping for a given instance ID from the InstanceColorMap class
get_all_instance_colors: get a copy of all instance color mappings from the InstanceColorMap class
reset_instance_color_map: reset and clear all instance color mappings in the InstanceColorMap class
